title: Customer badge shows the real loyalty tier
problem: The demo customer always showed a Gold badge, whatever they spent.
now: The badge is the loyalty tier from what the customer bought.
steps: The badge matches their spend (Member, Silver, Gold or Platinum).

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
